name: baseline-browser-mapping
localReason: Avoid the independently reproduced 2.11 timeline downstream-selection regression while backporting only process-termination safety.

changes.notice: /* Fee Insight modification, 2026-10-19: backport CVE-2026-45819 option errors as throws; original 2.9.19 browser data and API preserved. See backport provenance. */

replacements.before: if(console.log(new Error("KaiOS is a downstream browser and can only be included if you include other downstream browsers. Please ensure you use `includeDownstreamBrowsers: true`.")),"undefined"==typeof process||!process.exit)throw new Error("KaiOS configuration error: process.exit is not available");process.exit(1)
replacements.after: throw new Error("KaiOS is a downstream browser and can only be included if you include other downstream browsers. Please ensure you use `includeDownstreamBrowsers: true`.")

replacements.before: if(console.log(new Error("You cannot use targetYear and widelyAvailableOnDate at the same time.  Please remove one of these options and try again.")),"undefined"==typeof process||!process.exit)throw new Error("Configuration error: targetYear and widelyAvailableOnDate cannot be used together");process.exit(1)
replacements.after: throw new Error("You cannot use targetYear and widelyAvailableOnDate at the same time.  Please remove one of these options and try again.")
